messages.content: [Example message] Hey Sam.example! Saw your raised bed post — those look great. I've been thinking about growing some dye plants for my textile work. Any tips for a first-time gardener?
[Example message] Thanks! Dye plants are a great idea. Marigolds and indigo are pretty forgiving for beginners. Happy to share some seedlings if you want a head start.
[Example message] That would be amazing! I'll bring some fabric scraps to the next meetup so you can see what I'm working on.
[Example message] Sounds good. I'll bring the seedlings. See you there!
[Example message] Hi! I'm interested in joining your next workshop. Any spots open?
[Example message] Welcome! We have a few spots open for next Saturday. Sign up at the door or message us here to reserve.
